tasks.label: Port-forward: API 8000
args: kubectl -n platform-dev wait --for=condition=Ready pods -l app.kubernetes.io/instance=platform-api-dev --timeout=300s && exec kubectl -n platform-dev port-forward --address 0.0.0.0 svc/platform-api-dev-platform-api 8000:8000

tasks.label: Port-forward: Grafana 3000
args: kubectl -n monitoring rollout status deployment/monitoring-grafana --timeout=300s && exec kubectl -n monitoring port-forward --address 0.0.0.0 svc/monitoring-grafana 3000:80

tasks.label: Port-forward: Argo CD 8082
args: kubectl -n argocd rollout status deployment/argocd-server --timeout=300s && exec kubectl -n argocd port-forward --address 0.0.0.0 svc/argocd-server 8082:443

tasks.label: Port-forward: Prometheus 9090
args: kubectl -n monitoring rollout status statefulset/monitoring-kube-prometheus-prometheus --timeout=300s && exec kubectl -n monitoring port-forward --address 0.0.0.0 svc/monitoring-kube-prometheus-prometheus 9090:9090
